name: Silver Tiger Metals Inc.
summary: Silver Tiger Metals Inc. engages in the exploration and evaluation of mineral properties in Mexico. It primarily explores for gold, silver, copper, lead, and zinc deposits. The company holds 100% interest in the El Tigre property consist of 59 Mexican federal mining concessions covering an area of 37,000 hectares located in Sonora, Mexico. The company was formerly known as Oceanus Resources Corporation and changed its name to Silver Tiger Metals Inc. in May 2020. Silver Tiger Metals Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Halifax, Canada.
